tools.name: scan_webpage_ai_readiness
tools.description: Returns a readiness score, passed and failed checks, category results, top fixes, limitations, and a report link for one public webpage. Use it when someone asks whether a webpage is accessible and usable by AI agents; for checking an MCP server's directory compliance, use check_mcp_server_directory
